notes.title: Bugfixes & Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
[i]Marco & The Galaxy Dragon[/i] now supports Steam trading cards! Collect new community items including cards, badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds from all over the galaxy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36458200/4437c3682bc7ef10325b93d0c18729b1a1e7737b.jpg[/img]

The game has also received a couple of updates over the past month. We'll be summarizing the changes below!

[b]Version 1.03[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug which caused incorrect images and videos for the current Main Language to appear in some scenes.
[*]Corrected some text errors (typos).
[*]Adjusted some CGs to use the correct final art.
[*]Adjusted song names in Sound Mode.[/list]

[b]Version 1.02[/b]
[list][*]Hotfix for a launch bug in which some Achievements could not be correctly unlocked.[/list]
